thread:
Elena (CEO): morning all — quick weekly pulse; main asks: private beta -> GA checklist, adjust some SLA targets for Dedicated, and postmortem on the 2am outage. TL;DR: shipping delay for one Private connector, SLA tweak to 99.9 -> 99.95 for Priority customers for dedicated lanes, incident caused by DB failover race.

Ravi (VP Product): noted. For GA we're holding on the connector until the compliance sign-off (privacy team). can we shift the GA by 2 weeks? that gives time for the telemetry hooks + rollout plan. cc @Maya for release windows. :calendar:

Maya (Head of Eng): 2-week shift ok. engineering estimates: stabilize runtime perf for long-context models (90%ile token latency down ~12% with recent patch). will freeze model upgrades after next canary. deploy window: Thu 02:00-04:00 UTC (low traffic). I'll post runbook.

Luis (SRE Lead): incident summary: 02:12 UTC outage was a DB leader election + ephemeral node reprovision. Impact: 5.6% of requests across hostpool X, avg recovery 3m40s. Root cause: concurrent reprovision + aggressive healthcheck threshold. Mitigations: (1) backoff on reprovision, (2) tweak healthcheck success window to 30s, (3) add circuit for DB proxy. Patch planned for tomorrow morning. Logs: `svc-pool-3 error: leader_lost, reconnect_attempts=12`

Jordan (CFO): financial note: SLA change to 99.95 for Priority will increase support cost ~$18k/mo but reduces risk of partial downtimes for paying customers. We should present options: (A) 99.95 w/ higher reserve (recommended) (B) keep 99.9 + credit cap. I'll model both and share before Fri.

Elena (CEO): thanks. action items: Ravi — update GA calendar & comms draft; Maya — publish deploy runbook + canary checklist; Luis — ship DB reprovision backoff patch and post incident postmortem by EOD tomorrow; Jordan — cost scenarios and proposed customer messaging re SLA. I'll review comms and send to execs by Wed EOD. :wave:

Ravi (VP Product): will do. draft comms link: <https://docs.redwood.ai/internal/comm/prv-ga-draft> — feedback welcome. Suggest including an FAQ on the SLA change and migration options.

Maya (Head of Eng): putting runbook here: <https://runbooks.redwood.ai/private-ga/deploy-window-4201> includes rollback triggers and post-deploy latency checks. sample check: `grep p90 metrics | jq .latency <= 240`

Luis (SRE Lead): posting initial postmortem branch: <https://git.redwood.ai/ops/postmortems/4201234567-db-failover> — will iterate with incident responders. tagging on-call rotation change: add 2nd responder for DB leader events. :bell:

ops-bot: Deploy window scheduled for Thu 02:00 UTC. Reminder will be sent 24h prior. :robot_face:

Elena (CEO): okay — we'll treat this as one weekly thread. If anything urgent, DM me. Appreciate the quick triage and clear owners. :rocket:
